claims.text: Yes. Either party may terminate for convenience, but only after Contract Year 2 and on at least 60 calendar days' written notice to the other party.

citations.quote: Each Party may also terminate the Agreement for convenience after Contract Year 2 (as defined in Section 14.4) by providing written notice to the other Party at least sixty (60) calendar days prior to the effective date of such termination

claims.text: Contract Year 2 ended on January 31, 2021, so the convenience right is available only after that date.
